image_prompts.prompt: The character-consistent Triceratops from the config library at the starting line of the race track. SUBJECT ANCHOR: Dusty ochre skin with a thick, leathery texture; massive head frill is a SOLID, UNIFORM DEEP OCHRE with no patterns. ymmetrical burnt orange tiger-stripe patterns run along his flanks and hindquarters. Three polished off-white horns (two long brow horns, one shorter nose horn). ANATOMY ENFORCEMENT: Exactly three horns total; heavily muscled, stocky quadrupedal frame with pillar-like legs. ACTION: Standing squarely and immobile at the starting line, head lowered to showcase the frill's camouflage pattern. His front feet are planted firmly in the dirt, kicking up a small puff of dust to suggest his heavy weight. FACIAL EXPRESSION: A stoic, stubborn, and determined gaze with deep-set, soulful brown eyes. SETTING: The prehistoric outdoor dirt track start line; background features the LANCE_HELL_CREEK environment with palm-like Bennettitales and lush canopy foliage under a bright sun. ART STYLE: 'STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3'. LIGHTING: 'SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC'. FRAMING: 'SQUARE_HERO_CARD' front-three-quarter view to evaluate morphology and camouflage impact.
